title: feat(scenarios): name the roll-ups a persona is denied in the build prompt
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSW81HPmThVY9cna5EoPq7Fe)_

Fixes #37764

## What changes

- `PersonaSchema` gains an optional `withheldRollups` (a list of field refs, bare card names): the roll-ups on objects the persona reads that summarise rows or fields its `hidden` withholds. The schema refuses one the persona's `hidden` already names or its `allowedRollups` allows; the loader refuses one on a field no seed row of its object carries; `namespacedScenario` prefixes its objects like every other persona ref.
- `personaLine()` (build, door and every other prompt that carries the data contract) appends one clause when the key is present: `; the roll-up fields X and Y summarise what it must not read, so they are withheld too: its set must not read them either` (singular form for one field).
- `project_with_tasks`: `client_viewer` withholds `project.task_count` and `project.total_estimate`. `invoice_with_line_items`: `warehouse_staff` withholds `invoice.total`. The contractor already carries `project.total_estimate` in its `hidden`, so its line does not change.
- The scorer is untouched: `rollupSourceCharges` already charges a granted roll-up over withheld children, and the leak grader does not read the new key. No `allowedRollups` is added.
- README (roll-ups over withheld data) and a `patch` changeset.

## Why

Maintainer ruling 2026-11-27 01:42Z, quoted as given: 「客户角色能不能看到项目的任务数和总工时这类汇总数？」→「不能看，按明细权限屏蔽」. The scorer already charges these roll-ups, but the build prompt never said so, so the agent had to guess.

## Prompt diff

Every prompt (build short/detailed in en and zh, door build, iterate, every question and operation prompt) of all 9 open cards was rendered from `origin/main` 8b9b9d23 and from this branch and diffed. 7 cards are byte-identical (asset_lifecycle, crm_account_with_contacts, leave_balances, order_to_cash, requisition_to_receipt, service_desk, travel_expense). The two changed cards differ in exactly one line, the persona line, in each of the 5 build-style prompts:

```diff
- - `demoproject_client_viewer` for `client_viewer` (Client stakeholder who may not change tasks): must not read the object `demoproject_task`.
+ - `demoproject_client_viewer` for `client_viewer` (Client stakeholder who may not change tasks): must not read the object `demoproject_task`; the roll-up fields `demoproject_project.task_count` and `demoproject_project.total_estimate` summarise what it must not read, so they are withheld too: its set must not read them either.

- - `demoinvoice_warehouse_staff` for `warehouse_staff` (Warehouse staff who may read invoices but not change them): must not read the object `demoinvoice_account` or the field `demoinvoice_invoice_line.amount` or the field `demoinvoice_invoice_line.unit_price`.
+ - `demoinvoice_warehouse_staff` for `warehouse_staff` (Warehouse staff who may read invoices but not change them): must not read the object `demoinvoice_account` or the field `demoinvoice_invoice_line.amount` or the field `demoinvoice_invoice_line.unit_price`; the roll-up field `demoinvoice_invoice.total` summarises what it must not read, so it is withheld too: its set must not read it either.
```

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/units.test.ts`: three new tests (the two cards' persona lines carry the sentence and the contractor's and an unrelated card's lines are as before; the schema refusals; the loader refusal).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` (after `pnpm build` of the package): 44 files, 1364 passed, 14 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is `test/runner/packages.test.ts` › "every install ran the workspace's pinned pnpm", and it fails the same way with this branch's `src` and cards swapped back to `origin/main` in this container, so it is environmental here.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: clean. `eslint` on the changed sources: clean.
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:adr-0087-registration`: pass.

## Acceptance notes

- The card offered `personaLine()` or the two cards' persona text. The persona `role` string also feeds every operation prompt ("You act for ..."), so editing it would have changed those turns too, and the roll-up names are not derivable from the card otherwise. Hence a card-level key read only by `personaLine()`, the counterpart of `allowedRollups`.
- Sequenced with #37760 (same file, `prompts.ts`): whichever lands second rebases.

Clause-②: no
